title: Record in CLAUDE.md that a src-touching PR fires source-gates twice, a .quest/-only one once
description:
Per-repository fact established directly in this session across two live promotions (PR #24 into dev, then PR #26 dev->main; PR #22/#26 as the .quest/-only contrast), and per opum-agent's suggestion that it belongs in quest-cli's own CLAUDE.md repository-profile block rather than the fleet-wide operating block, which is generated byte-identical across repos and cannot safely carry a per-repo fact.

Observed, not inferred: a PR touching src/ (QCLI-272's fix, PR #24) had source-gates report twice on the same head SHA -- once from pull_request, once from push, because push is not path-filtered when the diff touches watched paths. mergeStateStatus stayed UNSTABLE until both went green. A .quest/-only PR (QCLI-269/270/271's promotion, PR #22/#26) never fired the push-triggered run at all -- source-gates reported once.

Also worth recording alongside it: the six-platform build matrix is not in the required-checks list, so it can sit pending/skipping indefinitely without blocking a merge -- the gate is the required check names, never the all-green rollup.

This is a documentation-only entry in the repository's own CLAUDE.md profile block (not the managed Quest block, not the fleet-wide operating file), following claude-md-edits-prompted-by-peers precedent: a peer-triggered, self-verified per-repo fact that grants no authority is fine to record without asking.

acceptanceCriteria.text: CLAUDE.md's Repository profile section (not the fleet-wide operating block, not the managed quest:agent-instructions block) states that a source-touching PR fires source-gates from both pull_request and push while a .quest/-only PR fires it once from pull_request only.
The same entry states that the six-platform build matrix is not in the required-checks list and can stay pending/skipping without blocking a merge.

finalSummary: Added a Repository profile entry to CLAUDE.md ('A source-touching PR fires source-gates twice; a .quest/-only one fires it once') recording two facts established directly in this session: (1) a PR touching src/ gets source-gates reported twice on the same head SHA -- once from pull_request, once from push, since push is not path-filtered when watched paths changed; mergeStateStatus stays UNSTABLE until both are green; a .quest/-only PR never fires the push-triggered run, so source-gates reports once. (2) the six-platform build matrix is not in the required-checks list and can sit pending/skipping without blocking a merge -- the gate is the required check names, never the all-green rollup. Placed in the hand-written Repository profile section, before the managed quest:agent-instructions block, matching the existing entries' style and the claude-md-edits-prompted-by-peers precedent (self-verified per-repo fact, peer-triggered, grants no authority). lore check exits 0, 63 files 0 errors.
